invariants.statement: Each claimed inspection context resolves exactly one hover / peek card.
Every card is keyboard-invocable, so pointer hover is never the only path to its content or provenance.
Every card carries visible provider / source provenance.
Every non-live card discloses its state inline with a non-color cue, never styled like live authoritative docs.
Every wrong-provider fallback card is non-live and discloses the fallback inline.
Every card with an inexact mapping discloses the mapping quality.
Every card whose raw and rendered forms differ materially offers a visible open-raw escape.
Every card pins a locked symbol / anchor identity and never silently retargets when a later provider answers.
Every promotion preserves the same provider / source labels and the return anchor.
Every content card offers keep-open / pin, open-in-tab, open-in-split, and dismiss-return.
Every pinned or promoted card preserves visible provenance and a freshness label, just like its transient form.
Every card carries a non-empty screen-reader label.
The diff / review and graph-linked explainer contexts each resolve a card, so hover / peek is consistent beyond plain file surfaces.
Every suppressed card stays keyboard-invocable, screen-reader labeled, and discloses its suppression.
Every context that is not full fidelity carries a visible degrade label and flags disclosure.
Every shared file context maps to a distinct canonical editor surface, so the surface vocabulary is reused, not forked.

summary: Hover-peek model frozen: 12 inspection contexts each resolve a hover / peek card. Every card is keyboard-invocable and provenance-labeled, never silently retargets, surfaces stale / partial / policy-limited / imported-snapshot / wrong-provider states inline, keeps raw and rendered forms distinguishable when they differ materially, and preserves the same provider / source / freshness labels and return anchor when pinned or promoted into a tab or split. All 16 invariants hold.
